name: Shure Wireless (ULX-D, QLX-D, SLX-D, Axient Digital)
notes: Actions and feedbacks are registered conditionally per receiver model family (ulx, qlx, slx, ad); the catalog lists the union.
Channel and slot dropdown ids are generated from the selected model (src/index.js). The field default is the string "1" while the generated channel ids are numbers.
Gain and frequency fields are textinputs parsed by the module code; they are not validated as numbers by Companion.
Built on @companion-module/base 1.x: no expressions; variables only in textinputs with useVariables.
